info.title: Paranormal Quantum Attention Networks: Discrete Graph Logics, Quantum Metalanguages, and Practical Architectures Beyond the Transformer

abstract.para: A scientific report on the design space of Paranormal Quantum Attention Networks (PQAN): neural architectures whose object language is a discrete propositional graph and whose metalanguage is a continuous, quantum-inspired system of amplitude-valued assertion degrees. The report situates the proposal against contemporary work on quantum transformers, density-matrix quantum natural language processing, tensor-network machine learning, hybrid quantum-classical (NISQ) computing, and paraconsistent, paracomplete, substructural, and non-reflexive logics for quantum theory, then argues for a near-term implementation strategy prioritizing tensor-network approximation with parameterized-quantum-circuit attention modules, and for natural language as the first testbed.
